original_target.title: A deterministic nontrivial growth exponent for planar DLA

scope_comparison: The 2025 published source explicitly retains existence and nontriviality of the DLA growth exponent and proves the Kesten upper bound only. The new layers-model theorem concerns finite layered graphs, not planar lattice harmonic measure from infinity. A secondary result that mislabels arXiv 2605.00997 was rejected after its actual abstract was checked (random-walk convex hulls, not DLA).
